rows.text: The implementation rules for the 2001 election at the joint plenary meeting in place of the party convention provide that the electors are the party's members of both Houses and three representatives of each prefectural federation, that a first-ballot majority of valid votes elects, that otherwise the top two go to an immediate run-off, and that the winner is reported to the joint plenary meeting.
